s1.syndrome_frame: Palpitations and exertional breathlessness with signs of cardiac dysfunction
salient_findings: Prominent y descent in jugular venous pressure
Irregular narrow complex tachycardia on ECG
key_facts: Antituberculous therapy for 6 months 10 years earlier
Jugular venous pressure with prominent y descent
Significant transmitral flow variations on echocardiography
ECG showed irregular narrow complex tachycardia
Ventricular rate of 78 bpm and atrial rate of 210 bpm on ECG

raw.syndrome_frame: Palpitations and exertional breathlessness with signs of cardiac dysfunction
salient_findings: Prominent y descent in jugular venous pressure
Irregular narrow complex tachycardia on ECG
key_facts: Antituberculous therapy for 6 months 10 years earlier
Jugular venous pressure with prominent y descent
Significant transmitral flow variations on echocardiography
ECG showed irregular narrow complex tachycardia
Ventricular rate of 78 bpm and atrial rate of 210 bpm on ECG

shortlist.label: Atrial Fibrillation
shortlist.why_kept: ECG showed irregular narrow complex tachycardia with a ventricular rate of 78 bpm and atrial rate of 210 bpm

shortlist.label: Atrial Flutter
shortlist.why_kept: ECG showed irregular narrow complex tachycardia and significant transmitral flow variations

shortlist.label: Constrictive Pericarditis
shortlist.why_kept: History of pulmonary tuberculosis and antituberculous therapy, with echocardiography showing biatrial dilatation and significant transmitral flow variations

shortlist.label: Restrictive Cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Echocardiography showed biatrial dilatation, normal biventricular systolic function, and grade III diastolic dysfunction

shortlist.label: Post-Chemotherapy Cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: History of metastatic bladder carcinoma and palliative chemotherapy, with echocardiography showing biatrial dilatation and diastolic dysfunction

raw.rationale: The ECG showed irregular narrow complex tachycardia with a ventricular rate of 78 bpm and atrial rate of 210 bpm, which is consistent with atrial fibrillation. Additionally, the patient presented with palpitations at rest, which is a common symptom of atrial fibrillation.

rejected.label: Atrial Flutter
rejected.why: Atrial flutter typically presents with a regular rhythm, whereas the patient's ECG showed an irregular rhythm.

rejected.label: Constrictive Pericarditis
rejected.why: Constrictive pericarditis would likely present with more pronounced signs of right heart failure, such as elevated jugular venous pressure and peripheral edema, which were not noted in the patient's examination.

rejected.label: Restrictive Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Restrictive cardiomyopathy would likely present with more significant symptoms of heart failure, such as severe exertional dyspnea and fatigue, which were not prominent in the patient's history.

rejected.label: Post-Chemotherapy Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of chemotherapy, the echocardiogram showed normal biventricular systolic function, which makes post-chemotherapy cardiomyopathy less likely.
